notes: v1.10.8 - Rules for some characters: every trigger, alias, timer, sequence and macro has an Only for box - character names, comma-separated - so one rule on an account can run for just the characters you name, and Move to... moves a rule to another layer (Global, a MUD, an account or one character) when you save; Settings now says that it applies to every world. Switching between connected characters keeps each output and chat pane where it was - at the newest line, or at the line you were reading - instead of throwing it back to the start of the session. A new or renamed MUD, account or character can no longer take a name another profile already has, which used to overwrite that profile. Plugin API 1.24: a scene3d widget draws a map in 3D (drag to turn and tilt, Shift+drag to pan, the wheel zooms; hover, click and right-click a point) with a 2D stand-in that the phone always shows, plus scrye.api and a widget height. Plugins since 1.10.7: 3S Map 1.19.0 shows every level at once in 3D, walks three steps at a time (fast walk), keeps walking when something attacks you, takes notes and favourite rooms, draws a split level a part at a time and says where the map's knowledge breaks whe…
